extracted.intended_audience: writers seeking literary representation (adult and children's authors), including new/unpublished writers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for submitting queries, manuscripts, and proposals to the literary agency Curtis Brown, Ltd.; explains required materials, topical scope, and agency terms. Aimed at authors (including unpublished writers) seeking representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify agent-specific query and submission guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: The Market List recommends you verify the query and/or submission guidelines for each literary agent and literary agency before sending a query or submitting your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check each agent's specific requirements rather than relying on general advice; guidelines can vary by agent and agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completed manuscript is often required
rubrics_metrics.description: Most agencies require a completed manuscript prior to queries or submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are an unpublished or new writer, confirm whether the agency expects a full manuscript or accepts partials/queries first.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review requirements for new or unpublished writers and areas of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Review and verify the agency requirements for working with new or unpublished writers as well as their specific areas of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm whether the agency is open to debut authors and whether your genre/topic matches the agents' stated interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required submission materials
rubrics_metrics.description: If you would like to submit a manuscript or proposal, please send us a query letter, a synopsis of the work, a sample chapter and a brief resume.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a concise query letter, a clear synopsis, a polished sample chapter (representative excerpt), and a short author resume; follow any agent-specific formatting or length limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market types represented
rubrics_metrics.description: Curtis Brown represents adult and children’s authors of all genres, including illustrators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency handles a broad range of genres and also represents illustrators for children's work; tailor submissions to relevant imprints/agents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted submission formats/genres
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your work falls within these accepted categories before querying; check agent notes for more granular preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency offers a written contract
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If representation is offered, expect a written contract; review terms carefully or seek professional advice before signing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency may charge for some postage
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency Terms: Charges for some postage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that the agency may require payment for certain postage or mailing costs in specific circumstances; confirm details if requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission/contact logistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission Address: Attn: Query Department, Ten Astor Place, New York NY 10003; Phone: (212) 473-5400. Web: www.curtisbrown.com
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send materials to the specified query department/address and use the provided phone/web contact for inquiries; follow any additional submission instructions on the agency website.
